graph-maintenance.notes: Routine automatic graph maintenance uses the separate Antigravity worker with bounded time/effort, real provider quotas and provenance verification. No per-run human approval is needed. Never grants the Director write authority, control-plane mutation or additional protected actions.

context-core.notes: Workspace/context access is runtime-native; Context7 is separately probed when requested.

architecture.notes: Most architecture capabilities are skills or local reasoning aids, not autonomous permissions.

workflow-design.notes: Profile-native workflow mapping and automation governance. These capabilities structure states, transitions, recovery, handoffs, observability and automation risk; they do not grant execution authority.

director-support.notes: Directors may discover candidate skills or run structured clarification; discovery never authorizes installation or persistent activation.

context-acquisition.notes: Context Curator may use bounded external structured acquisition when explicitly granted; Apify remains project-credential protected.

research.notes: External retrieval remains read-only; source authority is independent from retrieval tooling.

workspace-read.notes: Owner/private Google Workspace retrieval only. The Orbital wrapper permits schema inspection, dry-runs and HTTP GET methods; auth/export and write methods are blocked.

code-build.notes: devspace-write requires workspace-write mode and explicit scopes when the role requires them.

verification-runtime.notes: Read-only reviewers may execute deterministic commands/tests inside the read-only sandbox without receiving devspace-write or workspace-mutation authority.

content-build.notes: Local content assets may be written only inside explicit writeScopes; this does not grant software architecture or production mutation authority.

code-review.notes: Review capabilities do not imply permission to repair or integrate.

codebase-archaeology.notes: Historical drift review for duplicated implementations, orphaned configuration, competing conventions and stale documentation. Read-only by design.

diagnostics.notes: Workflow-level diagnostic skill is currently Antigravity-local and is requested only when a systematic workflow health scan is materially useful.

frontend.notes: Design skills and MCPs are situational; frontend mutation still flows through code-build.

motion-analysis.notes: Pinned Motiscope analysis can measure motion references and writes .motiscope artifacts only inside explicit workspace write scopes. Asset generation and skill installation are blocked by the Orbital wrapper.

visual-reference.notes: Reference discovery is read-only and does not authorize copying protected assets.

browser-qa.notes: JEV is the preferred fast path for simple DOM/ARIA interaction when its own preflight is eligible; unsupported or failed runs fall through to Playwright, which remains the broad browser QA route.

desktop-qa.notes: Native Windows QA is available only on a host where the narrow orbital-desktop-qa launcher materializes. The raw Windows Harness CLI is not a capability grant. Non-Windows/VPS hosts fail closed.

security.notes: Security review is read-only by default; offensive execution requires separate rules of engagement.

reliability.notes: Read-only observability and recovery analysis. Actual rollback is intentionally split into reliability-mutation and remains production-gated.

reliability-mutation.notes: Explicit production rollback capability. Never granted transitively to read-only reliability or release-review roles.

editorial.notes: Editorial generation is local/proposal-only; publication remains separately authorized.

documents.notes: PROFILE_ONLY specialization; does not widen the base runtime capability ceiling.

video.notes: Local edit/render is distinct from paid or externally billed generation.

social-graphics.notes: Asset generation may require explicit spend approval; publishing is never implicit.

growth.notes: Growth runtime remains proposal/read-only unless an external action is separately approved.

commercial-outbound.notes: Signal-based account selection, opportunity qualification and discovery preparation only. It does not authorize sending outreach, mutating CRM/account state or contacting prospects.

sales-engineering.notes: Pre-sales technical discovery, solution framing, POC scoping and proposal support. It does not authorize implementation, production mutation or external commitments.

data-acquisition.notes: Credentialed providers such as Apify require project authorization; bypasses are out of scope.

learning.notes: PROFILE_ONLY specialization; never creates an independent runtime grant.

google-workspace-read.notes: Use only through orbital-gws-readonly. The raw gws binary is intentionally not exposed on PATH; owner authentication is separate and human-controlled.

motion-reference-analysis.notes: Use only through orbital-motiscope. Analysis is local; asset generation, provider calls and persistent skill installation are not granted.

tts-generation.notes: Uses the local shared Gemini TTS broker (/dev/shm/orbital-tts-shared/tts.sock) with owner-managed API key pool; no paid-generation approval gate required.

video-generation.notes: Paid video generation requires an explicit capability grant; local editing and rendering do not imply this grant.

jev-ultrafast.notes: Self-preflight through tools/jev-ultrafast-canary/status.sh; the canary may use TypeSafe or the local Laya Fast Decision backend. Shadow/unverified Laya is not execution-eligible and must fall through to Playwright/System-2.

fast-decision.notes: Local System-1 decision service. Domain calibration, thresholds and safe choices are server-side and callers cannot self-promote a domain to selective execution.

payment-evidence.notes: Fail-closed payment evidence capability. Registered only when the deployed service, state store and secret receiver are verified healthy via read-only aggregate.
